answer: By the violet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. A crystal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the saffron of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
